security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI initializes PMP entries assuming a fixed or compile-time PMP_ENTRY_COUNT without probing the actual hardware limit, or writes PMP configurations to indices beyond the implementation-defined count and fails to verify via read-back that the write took effect, leaving memory regions silently unprotected.
security_spec.summary: PMP_ENTRY_COUNT is impl-def; OpenSBI iterating past the actual count silently fails writes (WARL reads back zero), creating a false sense of PMP coverage and enabling S-mode privilege escape through unprotected physical regions.
